name: CommandAttribute
declaration: public sealed class CommandAttribute : Attribute
summary: Declares a gameplay command: a static partial class with public static CommandResult Execute(ref CommandContext ctx, Entity target, ref C component, ...). Plain parameters become the params type agents and tools call it with; ref/in component parameters bind to the target entity's components. Commands are synchronous and capture no managed state, so they are prediction- and undo-safe.
